name: FEABench Gold — Executability
protocol: FEABench Gold 15 tasks, ModelSpecs input, one-shot prompting, paper-v1 executability metric; Valid Target and other prompt variants are excluded.

explanation.en: Each task scores the fraction of parsed API statements that execute correctly, averaged over the Gold set.
explanation.zh: 每题按解析出的 API 语句中可正确执行的比例计分，再在 Gold set 上取平均。

summary.en: FEABench tests generation of executable COMSOL finite-element simulation models from engineering specifications.
summary.zh: FEABench 测试模型根据工程规格生成可执行 COMSOL 有限元仿真模型的能力。

task_format.en: For 15 verified problems, the model receives complete model specifications and one example, then writes COMSOL Java API calls.
task_format.zh: 对 15 个验证任务，模型获得完整建模规格和一个示例，再生成 COMSOL Java API 调用。
